definitions.explanation: The place where someone or something is, especially when unknown or being searched for.
Where something is headed or how a situation will develop.

examples.japanese: {行方|ゆくえ}{不明|ふめい}の{子供|こども}が{見|み}つかった。
{彼|かれ}の{行方|ゆくえ}は{誰|だれ}も{知|し}らない。
この{会社|かいしゃ}の{行方|ゆくえ}が{心配|しんぱい}だ。
examples.english: I'm worried about the future of this company.

notes:
USAGE: {行方|ゆくえ} is often used in news reports and formal contexts when discussing missing persons or uncertain outcomes.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{行方|ゆくえ}{不明|ふめい} (missing, whereabouts unknown)
・{行方|ゆくえ}を{追|お}う (to track whereabouts)
・{行方|ゆくえ}を{捜|さが}す (to search for whereabouts)
・{行方|ゆくえ}が{分|わ}からない (whereabouts unknown)
・{行方|ゆくえ}を{見守|みまも}る (to watch how things develop)

RELATED:
・{所在|しょざい} - whereabouts (more formal)
・{居場所|いばしょ} - location, place to be
